summary.text: John Lawn is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Middlesex District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Lawn earned a degree in political science and sociology from Merrimack College, and his professional experience includes owning Charles River Real Estate.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on May 25, 2011.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Health Care Financing Joint Committee.
Lawn and his wife, Shannon, have five children.
